name: Vespa PX / P series
engine: 123-198 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, carb, four-speed hand-shift gearbox
intro: The classic geared Vespa. A two-stroke with a twist-grip gear change and a steel body that rusts underneath.

add.title: Check the floor and frame for rust
add.instructions: Look under the floor mat, along the runners and under the engine cowls. The steel body is the frame, so rust here is structural.
add.reason: Vespa bodies are monocoque, and floor rust is the classic killer.

add.title: Check the oil supply
add.instructions: Find out if it is premix or has autolube. On autolube bikes, check the oil tank and pump line. On premix, mix fuel and oil at the ratio for your model.
add.reason: A two-stroke with no oil seizes quickly.

J: Gear and clutch cables run from the left grip. Adjust them together so the gears select cleanly.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
